name: Acid Burrower
text: _A horse-sized insect with digging claws and acidic blood._
motives: Burrow, drag away, feed, reposition

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Burrower can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Earth Eruption
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Burrower burst out of the ground. All creatures within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or be knocked over, making them _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they next act.

features.name: Spit Acid
features.text: Make an attack against all targets in front of the Burrower within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets the Burrower succeeds against take **2d6** physical damage and must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}, they must mark an additional {{term:hit-points|HP}} and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Acid Bath
features.text: When the Burrower takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}, all creatures within {{term:close|Close range}} are bathed in their acidic blood, taking **1d10** physical damage. This splash covers the ground within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with blood, and all creatures other than the Burrower who move through it take **1d6** physical damage.

name: Bear
text: _A large bear with thick fur and powerful claws._
motives: Climb, defend territory, pummel, track

features.name: Overwhelming Force
features.text: Targets who mark {{term:hit-points|HP}} from the Bear’s standard attack are knocked back to {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

features.name: Bite
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, deal **3d4+10** physical damage and the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they break free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Bear makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Ahuizotl
text: _A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a_ _long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them._
motives: Ambush, drown, restrain

features.name: Aquatic Attacker
features.text: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has {{term:advantage|advantage}} on the attack and deals an extra **1d6** damage.

features.name: Tail Swat
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage.

features.name: Drag and Bag
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within {{term:close|Close range}} with its tail, pull the target into {{term:melee|Melee range}}, and {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ them. The Ahuizotl has {{term:advantage|advantage}} on attacks against targets _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ in this way.

name: Atototl
text: _A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is_ _hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach._
motives: Avoid, escape, misdirect

features.name: Wind Lord
features.text: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}}.

features.name: Stone of Omens
features.text: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl’s remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains {{term:hope|Hope}} equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain {{term:fear|Fear}} equal to half the result.

features.name: Archer’s Bane
features.text: When a creature beyond {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker’s damage back to them.

name: Cave Ogre
text: _A massive humanoid who sees all sapient life as food._
motives: Bite off heads, feast, rip limbs, stomp, throw enemies

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Ogre. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Bone Breaker
features.text: The Ogre’s attacks deal {{term:direct-damage|direct damage}}.

features.name: Hail of Boulders
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to pick up heavy objects and throw them at all targets in front of the Ogre within {{term:far|Far range}}. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Ogre succeeds against take **1d10+2** physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Rampaging Fury
features.text: When the Ogre marks 2 or more {{term:hit-points|HP}}, they can rampage. Move the Ogre to a point within {{term:close|Close range}} and deal **2d6+3** direct physical damage to all targets in their path.

name: Bugboar
text: _A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur._
motives: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

features.name: Surprise!
features.text: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it’s marked {{term:hit-points|HP}} or {{term:stress|Stress}}, it has {{term:advantage|advantage}} on the attack and deals an extra **1d8** damage.

features.name: Brutal
features.text: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to deal an extra **1d6** damage.

features.name: Warheart
features.text: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to negate it.

name: Common Ruffian
text: _A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others._
motives: Do violence, seek security and survival

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Ruffians within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. The Ruffians move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal **1d8** physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.text: When the Ruffian marks half their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Construct
text: _A roughly humanoid being of stone and steel, assembled and_ _animated by magic._
motives: Destroy environment, serve creator, smash target, trample groups

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Construct can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Weak Structure
features.text: When the Construct marks {{term:hit-points|HP}} from physical damage, they must mark an additional {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Trample
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against all targets in the Construct’s path when they move. Targets the Construct succeeds against take **1d8** physical damage.

features.name: Overload
features.text: Before rolling damage for the Construct’s attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} again.

features.name: Death Quake
features.text: When the Construct marks their last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. Make an attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}} against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets the Construct succeeds against take **1d12+2** magic damage.

name: Courtier
text: _An ambitious and ostentatiously dressed socialite._
motives: Discredit, gain favor, maneuver, scheme

features.name: Mockery
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to say something mocking and force a target within {{term:close|Close range}} to make a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (14) to see if they can save face. On a failure, the target must mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} and is _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until the scene ends.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** and target a PC. The Courtier convinces a crowd or prominent individual that the target is the cause of their current conflict or misfortune.

name: Darkweave Crawler
text: _A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk._
motives: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Skin-Crawling
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to force all PCs within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the Crawler to mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Darkweave Crawlers within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Darkweave Venom
features.text: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to _Exhaust_ the target until they succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (9). While _Exhausted_, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} each time they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}.

name: Deeproot Defender
text: _A burly vegetable-person with grasping vines._
motives: Ambush, grab, protect, pummel

features.name: Ground Slam
features.text: Slam the ground, knocking all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} back to {{term:far|Far range}}. Each target knocked back this way must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Grab and Drag
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to pull them into {{term:melee|Melee range}}, deal **1d6+2** physical damage, and _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ them until the Defender takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}.

name: Darkweave Queen
text: _A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten_ _god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim._
motives: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} her.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}_._

features.name: Den Mother
features.text: Once per scene, **spend 2 {{term:fear|Fear}}** to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within {{term:close|Close range}} and immediately take the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}_._

features.name: Quicker Than She Looks
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to move up to {{term:far|Far range}} and make a standard attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}}_._

features.name: Darkfang Envenomation
features.text: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make the target _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (12) or take a rest.

name: Darkweave Spinner
text: _A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk._
motives: Bite, stick to the darkness

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, the target is _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.text: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make the target _Shaky_ until they succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll (10). While _Shaky_, the target has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings
text: _A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk._
motives: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

features.name: Horde (1d4)
features.text: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **1d4** physical damage instead.

features.name: “Get ’em Off, Get ’em Off !”
features.text: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark {{term:hit-points|HP}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make the target {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Covered in Spiders._ While _Covered_ _in Spiders,_ the target must roll a **d6** when they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} or you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Dire Wolf
text: _A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone._
motives: Defend territory, harry, protect pack, surround, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target, deal **1d6+5** physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Hobbling Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, deal **3d4+10** direct physical damage and make them _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they clear at least 1 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Giant Mosquitoes
text: _Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection._
motives: Fly away, harass, steal blood

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}.

features.name: Bloodsucker
features.text: When the Mosquitoes’ attack causes a target to mark {{term:hit-points|HP}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force the target to mark an additional {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Giant Rat
text: _A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival._
motives: Burrow, hunger, scavenge, wear down

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Giant Rats within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Giant Scorpion
text: _A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail._
motives: Ambush, feed, grapple, poison

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against two targets within {{term:melee|Melee range}}.

features.name: Venomous Stinger
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to deal **1d4+4** physical damage and _Poison_ them until their next rest or they succeed on a {{term:knowledge|Knowledge}} Roll (16). While _Poisoned_, the target must roll a **d6** before they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Elk
text: _A large deer._
motives: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

features.name: Headbutt
features.text: When the Elk moves from {{term:close|Close range}} or farther before making a standard attack, it deals **1d12+2** physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.text: When the Elk marks a {{term:hit-points|HP}} or {{term:stress|Stress}}, it must succeed on a {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (10) or flee the scene.

name: Falcon
text: _A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak._
motives: Circle, clutch, dive, spy

features.name: Nimble Flyer
features.text: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}.

features.name: Dive Bomb
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Grimmling Warband
text: _A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from_ _trash and stolen housewares._
motives: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Warband has marked half or more of its {{term:hit-points|HP}}, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Cowardly
features.text: When the Warband marks its last {{term:stress|Stress}} or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a **d6**. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

name: Glass Snake
text: _A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard_ _trail wherever they go._
motives: Climb, feed, keep distance, scare

features.name: Armor-Shredding Shards
features.text: After a successful attack against the Snake within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, the attacker must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}. If they can’t mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}, they must mark an {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Spinning Serpent
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets the Snake succeeds against take **1d6+1** physical damage.

features.name: Spitter
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to introduce a **d6** Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within {{term:far|Far range}} must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **1d4** physical damage. The Snake can take the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} a second time this GM turn.

name: Archer Guard
text: _A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the_ _settlement’s colors._
motives: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Hobbling Shot
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to deal **1d12+3** physical damage. If the target marks {{term:hit-points|HP}} from this attack, they have {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on {{term:agility|Agility}} Rolls until they clear at least 1 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Bladed Guard
text: _An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the_ _settlement’s colors._
motives: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Shield Wall
features.text: A creature who tries to move within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the Guard must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of another guard in the line, the {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}} increases by the total number of guards in that line.

features.name: Detain
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ the target until they break free with a successful attack, {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll, or {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll.

name: Head Guard
text: _A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice._
motives: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

features.name: Rally Guards
features.text: **Spend 2 {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Head Guard and up to **2d4** allies within {{term:far|Far range}}.

features.name: On My Signal
features.text: _Countdown (5)_. When the Head Guard is in the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} for the first time, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within {{term:far|Far range}} make a standard attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}} against the nearest target within their range. If any attacks succeed on the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Jagged Knife Lieutenant
text: _A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and_ _cunning eyes._
motives: Bully, command, profit, reinforce

features.name: Tactician
features.text: When you {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Lieutenant, **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** to also {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} two allies within {{term:close|Close range}}.

features.name: More Where That Came From
features.text: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at {{term:far|Far range}}.

features.name: Coup de Grace
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make an attack against a _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ target within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, deal **2d6+12** physical damage and the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Jagged Knife Shadow
text: _A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow_ _magic to isolate targets._
motives: Ambush, conceal, divide, profit

features.name: Backstab
features.text: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has {{term:advantage|advantage}}, they deal **1d6+6** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Cloaked
features.text: Become _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ until after the Shadow’s next attack. Attacks made while _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ from this feature have {{term:advantage|advantage}}.

name: Jagged Knife Sniper
text: _A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow._
motives: Ambush, hide, profit, reposition

features.name: Unseen Strike
features.text: If the Sniper is _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal **1d10+4** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

name: Kelpie
text: _A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form_ _in and out of the water._
motives: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

features.name: Captivating
features.text: A PC must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} to move out of the Kelpie’s {{term:melee|Melee range}}.

features.name: Heart’s Desire
features.text: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Shapeshifter
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to change the Kelpie’s physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Enchant
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within {{term:close|Close range}}. The PC must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or become _Enchanted_ until they take damage. While _Enchanted_, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC’s most deeply held morals.

name: Masque Muerte
text: _The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler._
motives: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

features.name: Libre
features.text: The Masque Muerte can’t be _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_.

features.name: Heel Turn
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a PC within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and is {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

features.name: Spectral Suplex
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Masque Muerte suplex a _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ PC, dealing **1d10+6** magic damage to them.

features.name: Unmasking Death
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within {{term:close|Close range}} must succeed on a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Tag Team
features.text: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have a spectral wrestler appear and _Pin_ the target until they escape with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll. While _Pinned_, the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ and takes an extra **1d12** magic damage from the Masque Muerte’s attacks.

name: Mechanorb
text: _A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes_ _from a realm of machines and metal._
motives: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

features.name: Hive Mind
features.text: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}} for each other Mechanorb within {{term:close|Close range}}.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics
features.text: _Pool._ When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} or is defeated.

name: Merchant
text: _A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain._
motives: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit

features.name: Preferential Treatment
features.text: A PC who succeeds on a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on future {{term:presence|Presence}} Rolls against the Merchant.

features.name: The Runaround
features.text: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Minor Chaos Elemental

motives: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

features.name: Fast
features.text: The Hut can move up to {{term:far|Far range}} when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.text: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ the target. The Hut drags the _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ target when it moves.

name: Conscript
text: _A poorly trained civilian pressed into war._
motives: Follow orders, gang up, survive

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Conscripts within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Courtesan
text: _An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts._
motives: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons

features.name: Searing Glance
features.text: When a PC within {{term:close|Close range}} makes a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target’s failure, they must mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} and are _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target’s success, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Cult Adept
text: _An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear._
motives: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge

features.name: Enervating Blast
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Shroud of the Fallen
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to wrap an ally within {{term:close|Close range}} in a shroud of _Protection_ until the Adept marks their last {{term:hit-points|HP}}. While _Protected_, the target has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to all damage.

features.name: Shadow Shackles
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** and choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point are _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ in smoky chains until they break free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} or {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll. A target _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ by this feature must spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} to make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}.

features.name: Fear Is Fuel
features.text: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with {{term:fear|Fear}}, clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Cult Fang
text: _A professional killer-turned-cultist._
motives: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks

features.name: Shadow’s Embrace
features.text: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to move from one shadow to another within {{term:far|Far range}}.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to cause a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}} to make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. On a failure, the target must mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within {{term:far|Far range}}, making them {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_. On a success, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Cult Initiate
text: _A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power._
motives: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Cult Initiates within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Demonic Hound Pack
text: _Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire._
motives: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Pack has marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Dreadhowl
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}. If a target is not able to lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}, they must instead mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Dire Pangolati
text: _A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It_ _has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales._
motives: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

features.name: Armor Eater
features.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **2d8** physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.text: When the Pangolati would mark {{term:hit-points|HP}} from an attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to reduce the number of {{term:hit-points|HP}} it marks by 1.

name: Doppelhound
text: _A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed,_ _whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate_ _of itself._
motives: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive

features.name: Blink Beast
features.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within {{term:close|Close range}} of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate’s. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate’s place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

name: Dragon Knight
text: _A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a_ _dragon’s head._
motives: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off -balance, strike from above

features.name: High Ground
features.text: The Knight gains {{term:advantage|advantage}} on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Knight leap into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of a target within {{term:far|Far range}} and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to reroll the attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}}.

name: Electric Eels
text: _A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute._
motives: Avoid larger predators, shock prey, tear apart

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Eels have marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Paralyzing Shock
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. You gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} for each target that marks {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Elephant
text: _A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk._
motives: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize

features.name: Trample
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Elephant charge up to {{term:far|Far range}} in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **2d10+3** physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have it toss the target to another location within {{term:close|Close range}} and deal an extra **1d12** damage.

name: Elite Soldier
text: _An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance._
motives: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances

features.name: Reinforce
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, deal **2d10+2** physical damage and the ally can clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Vassal’s Loyalty
features.text: When the Soldier is within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of them and take the damage instead.

name: Entombed Cat Beast
text: _A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther’s skull for a head._
motives: Rush attack, shred, terrify

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.text: A PC who marks 3 or more {{term:hit-points|HP}} from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force each PC within {{term:far|Far range}} of the Cat Beast to make a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail become _Rattled_ until they roll with {{term:hope|Hope}}. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a _Rattled_ PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the _Rattled_ condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against that PC.

name: Entombed Elite Guard
text: _An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb_ _from theft and desecration._
motives: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one

features.name: Battle Formation
features.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}} for each ally within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

features.name: Javelin
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

name: Entombed Empress
text: _The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She’s been given blasphemous_ _funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on._
motives: Command inferiors, curse the invaders

features.name: Empty Husk
features.text: The Empress has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.text: The Empress’s internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Empress target a creature within {{term:close|Close range}} and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into {{term:melee|Melee range}}, deals **2d8** physical damage, and {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Restrains_ them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} any number of allies within {{term:close|Close range}}. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.text: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with {{term:fear|Fear}}. When it triggers, the PC marks all {{term:hit-points|HP}} and makes a {{term:death-move|death move}}. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Empress marks her last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

name: Entombed Necropriest
text: _A necromancer charged with preserving the empress’s life beyond_ _death._
motives: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon

features.name: Invigorate
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to choose up to three allies within {{term:far|Far range}}. Each one gains {{term:advantage|advantage}} on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a PC within {{term:far|Far range}}. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC’s feet and _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ them until the PC breaks free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll. When a target _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ in this way spends {{term:hope|Hope}}, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark **1d4** {{term:stress|Stress}}. If the target marks their last {{term:stress|Stress}} from this attack, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Entombed Skin Beetles
text: _Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin._
motives: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Omophagous
features.text: **Mark a {{term:hit-points|HP}}** to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, forcing them to mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and _Infecting_ them. While _Infected_, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a {{term:hit-points|HP}} or a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Entombed Stonemason
text: _An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their_ _empress’s tomb from the inside._
motives: Never stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Entombed Stonemasons within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can **spend** **a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to clear the Stonemason’s {{term:hit-points|HP}} and {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Flock of Feather Fiends
text: _A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light._
motives: Caw incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes

features.name: Horde (1d6+1)
features.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its {{term:hit-points|HP}}, its standard attack deals **1d6+1** magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force each PC within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} to make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail must spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} or become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

name: Failed Experiment
text: _A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them_ _warped and ungainly._
motives: Devour, hunt, track

features.name: Warped Fortitude
features.text: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, the Experiment deals double damage.

features.name: Lurching Lunge
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Fowlbear
text: _A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose._
motives: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within {{term:close|Close range}} must make a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}, move away from the Fowlbear to {{term:far|Far range}}, and become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} or move away from the Fowlbear to {{term:far|Far range}}.

name: Fungispunj Sporeling
text: _A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from_ _attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores._
motives: Avoid violence, spray attackers

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Fungispunj Sporelings within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

name: Fungispunj Sporophore
text: _A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead._
motives: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within {{term:close|Close range}}. Each PC must succeed on a {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or become _Poisoned_ until they spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} to clear the condition. While _Poisoned_, a target must roll a **d6** before they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Reanimator
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all {{term:hit-points|HP}} and {{term:stress|Stress}}, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.text: **Mark any number of {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within {{term:close|Close range}}.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.text: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark {{term:stress|Stress}} from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that {{term:stress|Stress}} in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

name: Gargoyle
text: _A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon._
motives: Hide in plain sight, overwatch, swoop down

features.name: Unliving
features.text: The Gargoyle has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to magic damage.

features.name: Swooping Strike
features.text: Choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

features.name: Petrifying Slash
features.text: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_. If the target is already _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}},_ they become _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_. If the target is already _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}},_ they must make a {{term:death-move|death move}}. The PC can spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} per condition to clear it.

name: Giant Beastmaster
text: _A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow._
motives: Command, make a living, maneuver, pin down, protect companion animals

features.name: Two as One
features.text: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

features.name: Pinning Strike
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they break free with a successful {{term:finesse|Finesse}} or {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll.

features.name: Deadly Companion
features.text: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster’s control. The adversary appears at {{term:close|Close range}} and is immediately spotlighted.

name: Giant Brawler
text: _An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger_ _than a human._
motives: Make a living, overwhelm, slam, topple

features.name: Battering Ram
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within {{term:close|Close range}} they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the object must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **2d4+3** physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.text: When the Brawler marks 2 or more {{term:hit-points|HP}} from an attack within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals **2d6+15** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Giant Eagle
text: _A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons._
motives: Hunt prey, stay mobile, strike decisively

features.name: Flight
features.text: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to attack a target within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, deal **2d10+2** physical damage and knock the target over, making them _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they next act.

features.name: Take Off
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, deal **2d4+3** physical damage and the target must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or become {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ within the Eagle’s massive talons. If the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to {{term:very-far|Very Far range}} above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.text: While flying, the Eagle can drop a _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ but starts falling. If their fall isn’t prevented during the PCs’ next action, the target takes **2d20** physical damage when they land.

name: Giant Octopus
text: _A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms_ _and a hard, beaklike jaw._
motives: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.text: When the Octopus first appears, place a **d8** on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die’s value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die’s value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.text: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Octopus _Grapple_ the target. While _Grappled_, the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ and _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they break free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} or {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to deal **3d8** direct physical damage to a target _Grappled_ by the Octopus.

name: Giant Recruit
text: _A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor._
motives: Batter, make a living, overwhelm, terrify

features.name: Minion (7)
features.text: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Giant Recruits within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Gobstalker
text: _A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle_ _of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams._
motives: Ambush rivals, seek riches, shoot beams

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
features.text: The Gobstalker’s rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within {{term:close|Close range}} of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.text:
**Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to attack a target within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, roll a **d8** for a random beam attack or **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose instead:

1. **_Beguile._** The Gobstalker _Beguiles_ the target. While _Beguiled_, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can’t attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with {{term:fear|Fear}}, a _Beguiled_ PC must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A _Beguiled_ PC must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll (16) to clear the condition.
2. **_Corrode._** The target takes **2d8** magic damage and must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t, double the damage.
3. **_Doom._** The target must mark all {{term:hit-points|HP}}, but they can spend any number of {{term:hope|Hope}} to reduce the number of {{term:hit-points|HP}} marked this way by an equal amount.
4. **_Hypnosis._** The target falls into a _Deep Trance_ and can’t act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll (16).
5. **_Paralyze._** The target freezes in place, becoming _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}.
6. **_Sear._** The target takes **2d8** direct magic damage.
7. **_Scare._** The target is _Scared_. While _Scared_, the target can’t take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} whenever you spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}. The target can clear the condition with a successful {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll (16).
8. **_Slow._** The target becomes _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} to move until they spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.text: On a successful standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to clear a number of {{term:stress|Stress}} equal to the number of {{term:hit-points|HP}} the target marked.

name: Gorgon
text: _A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that_ _their peace has been disturbed._
motives: Corner, hit-and-run, petrify, seek vengeance

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Sunsear Arrows
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target _Glows_ until the end of the scene and can’t become _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_. Attack rolls made against a _Glowing_ target have {{term:advantage|advantage}}.

features.name: Crown of Serpents
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}} using the Gorgon’s protective snakes. On a success, **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to deal **2d10+4** physical damage and the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.text: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within {{term:close|Close range}}, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to force the attacker to make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a {{term:hit-points|HP}} and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This {{term:countdown|countdown}} ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a {{term:death-move|death move}}. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification {{term:countdown|countdowns}} end.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Guahalan Alebrujo
text: _A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals._
motives: Destroy, give no quarter, ravage

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.text: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of {{term:fear|Fear}} you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, then clear a {{term:hit-points|HP}} or a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within {{term:far|Far range}} must succeed on a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or become {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _Panicked_. While _Panicked_, a PC must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} when they take the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make a standard attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}}. On a success, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking {{term:stress|Stress}} to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.text: When the Alebrujo deals {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to force all targets within {{term:close|Close range}} to mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Guahalan Fang Lord
text: _A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle._
motives: Bolster allies, lead the pack, rally the troops

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.text: _Pool_. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within {{term:close|Close range}} makes an attack, you can **spend a token** from the Guahalan Pool to give them {{term:advantage|advantage}} on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of {{term:stress|Stress}} they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to {{term:far|Far range}} instead of {{term:close|Close range}} before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.text: **Spend 2 {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Guahalan Shifters within {{term:close|Close range}}. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Fang Lord marks their last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

name: Guahalan Shifter
text: _A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features._
motives: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of {{term:stress|Stress}} they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to {{term:far|Far range}} instead of {{term:close|Close range}} before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the target.

name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
text: _A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal._
motives: Protect, sacrifice, surround

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.text: The Spirit Beast has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.text: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within {{term:melee|Melee range}}.

name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
text: _A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features._
motives: Abjure, bolster, summon

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of {{term:stress|Stress}} they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to {{term:far|Far range}} instead of {{term:close|Close range}} before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Spirit Singer summon **2d4** Guahalan Spirit Beasts within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} and immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} and have each one move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.text: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

name: Hill Titan
text: _A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects._
motives: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Gullible
features.text: PCs have {{term:advantage|advantage}} on {{term:action-roll|action rolls}} to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.text: PCs are _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ while within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make a standard attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

name: Hive Walker
text: _A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees._
motives: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive

features.name: Blood Honey
features.text: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within {{term:close|Close range}}. Each target in that line must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **2d8** magic damage and become {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.text: When the Walker marks {{term:hit-points|HP}}, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **1d8** direct physical damage for each {{term:hit-points|HP}} the Hive Walker has marked. _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ targets automatically fail the {{term:reaction-roll|reaction roll}}.

name: Jack-O’-Lantern
text: _A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The_ _soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow._
motives: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Jack-o’-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o’-Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Jack-o’-Lanterns within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.text: When a PC within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} rolls with {{term:fear|Fear}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to gain an additional {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Juvenile Flickerfly
text: _A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings_ _moving faster than the eye can see._
motives: Collect shiny things, hunt, swoop

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Peerless Accuracy
features.text: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the target’s {{term:evasion|Evasion}} is halved against this attack.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} must make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. For each target who failed, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} and the Flickerfly learns one of the target’s fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.text: _Countdown (Loop 1d6)_. When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to {{term:far|Far range}}. Targets must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Knight of the Realm
text: _A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed._
motives: Run down, seek glory, show dominance

features.name: Chevalier
features.text: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}. When they take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}, they’re knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they’re next spotlighted.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.text: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

features.name: Cavalry Charge
features.text: If the Knight is mounted, move up to {{term:far|Far range}} and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal **2d8+4** physical damage and the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: For the Realm!
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} **1d4+1** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: Landshark
text: _A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground._
motives: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey

features.name: Burrowing
features.text: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to all damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.text: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of {{term:hit-points|HP}}, you can mark an equal number of {{term:stress|Stress}} instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.text: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to force the target to mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

name: Landshark Behemoth
text: _A landshark that’s lived long enough to become a large burrowing_ _monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth._
motives: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.text: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is {{term:immunity|immune}} to damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.text: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.text: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} to succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or be knocked over, becoming _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. For each PC made _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ in this way, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Masked Thief
text: _A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic._
motives: Evade, hide, pilfer, profit

features.name: Quick Hands
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target’s inventory.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the trap must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. A target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ and _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful {{term:finesse|Finesse}} or {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (13).

name: Merchant Baron
text: _An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their_ _command._
motives: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: Everyone Has a Price
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} or take the deal.

features.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
features.text: Once per scene, **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** to summon **1d4+1** Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at {{term:far|Far range}}, to enforce the Baron’s will.

name: Minotaur Wrecker
text: _A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper._
motives: Consume, gore, navigate, overpower, pursue

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Charging Bull
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to charge through a group within {{term:close|Close range}} and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur’s path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take **2d6+8** physical damage and are knocked back to {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra **1d6** damage (combine the damage).

features.name: Gore
features.text: Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, moving the Minotaur into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of them. On a success, deal **2d8** direct physical damage.

name: Mortal Hunter
text: _An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes_ _and a casually cruel demeanor._
motives: Devour, hunt, track

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within {{term:far|Far range}} lose a {{term:hope|Hope}} and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Deathlock
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to curse a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with a necrotic _Deathlock_ until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a _Deathlocked_ target deal {{term:direct-damage|direct damage}}. The Hunter can only maintain one _Deathlock_ at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.text: _Countdown (Loop 1d6)_. When the Hunter is in the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} for the first time, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within {{term:far|Far range}} and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

name: Ravenous Mockery
text: _A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate_ _objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range._
motives: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to attack a creature within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, the target is pulled into {{term:melee|Melee range}} with the Mockery and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they escape with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll, and you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to activate the Mockery’s Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Attack a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, the Mockery _Swallows_ the target. While _Swallowed_, the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ and marks a {{term:hit-points|HP}} when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all _Swallowed_ creatures when it takes Major or {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}.

features.name: Never Just One
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

name: Royal Advisor
