features.text: Creatures within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the Gaoler have {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are {{term:immunity|immune}} to this feature.

features.name: Lock Up
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ within the Gaoler until freed with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (18). While _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

name: Vault Guardian Sentinel
text: _A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace_ _for a hand._
motives: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect

features.name: Kinetic Slam
features.text: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel’s standard attack are knocked back to {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}.

features.name: Box In
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to choose a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} to focus on. That target has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls when they’re within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to lob explosive magic at a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of that point must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **2d8+20** magic damage and are knocked back to {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren’t knocked back.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Vault Guardian Turret
text: _A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston-_ _driven mechanical legs._
motives: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect

features.name: Slow Firing
features.text: When you {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Turret and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to _Mark_ a target within {{term:far|Far range}} until the Turret is destroyed or the _Marked_ target becomes _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_. While the target is _Marked_, their {{term:evasion|Evasion}} is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within {{term:far|Far range}} of the Turret, you can **mark** **a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to add the Turret’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.text: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within {{term:close|Close range}} must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **3d20** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Viscera Sucker
text: _A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly_ _through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper_ _body with hanging entrails._
motives: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Join or Die
features.text: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn’t reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, _Restraining_ them until they escape with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. The target marks a {{term:hit-points|HP}}, and the Viscera Sucker clears a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Whisper Wraith
text: _The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting_ _as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely_ _humanoid shape._
motives: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads

features.name: Greater Specter
features.text: The Wraith has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Spooky
features.text: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within {{term:close|Close range}} must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}, and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Nightmare Shroud
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, _Shrouding_ the target until they succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While _Shrouded,_ the target has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls and marks a {{term:stress|Stress}} when they roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the _Shrouded_ target.

name: Wyvern
text: _A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour_ _livestock._
motives: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within {{term:far|Far range}} are _Terrified_ until they succeed on a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While _Terrified_, a PC doesn’t gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} when they roll with {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Clutch
features.text: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Wyvern _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ in this way, the PC has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls.

name: Young Fire Dragon
text: _A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings._
motives: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.text: When you spend a {{term:fear|Fear}} to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Dragon, all PCs within {{term:close|Close range}} must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} or lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Flame Breath
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within {{term:close|Close range}}. Each target must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **4d8+3** magic damage. features.name: Eruption
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. features.name: Blazing Scales
features.text: When a creature within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} and can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

name: Young Ice Dragon
text: _A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged_ _wings._
motives: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul

features.name: Relentless (3)

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.text: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn’t mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} to reduce the damage, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: No Hope
features.text: When a PC rolls with {{term:fear|Fear}} while within {{term:far|Far range}} of the Dragon, they lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.text: **Spend 2 {{term:fear|Fear}}** to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within {{term:close|Close range}}. All targets in this area must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **4d6+5** magic damage and are _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ by ice until they break free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets within this area must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the {{term:reaction-roll|reaction roll}}, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and become _Chilled_ until their next rest or they clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}. features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

name: Arch-Necromancer
text: _A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes._
motives: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect

features.name: Dance of Death
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}**.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.text: **Mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}** to cause all targets within {{term:far|Far range}} to make a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **2d20+12** magic damage and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more {{term:hit-points|HP}} must also mark **2 {{term:stress|Stress}}** and becomes _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they roll with {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at {{term:close|Close range}} and immediately takes the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}.

features.text: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.text: _Countdown (Loop 2d6)_. When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. name: Cephilith Abomination
text: _A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches_ _visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin._
motives: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab

features.name: Toxic Skin
features.text: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} or 2 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Bear Hug
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against a target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is _Grappled_ until they escape with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll. While _Grappled_, the target is _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_.

features.name: Crunch!
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to deal **4d12** direct physical damage to a creature _Grappled_ by the Abomination.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Abomination pull a target within {{term:far|Far range}} into {{term:melee|Melee range}}, then immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Abomination again.

features.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
features.text: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. name: Cephilith Hatchling
text: _A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey’s skull, bathing the_ _victim’s brain in extradimensional neurotoxins._
motives: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Comatize
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. The PC must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} as the Hatchling injects the PC’s brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional {{term:stress|Stress}} each time any PC fails a roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of {{term:hope|Hope}} equal to the number of {{term:stress|Stress}} they have marked. If a PC marks their last {{term:stress|Stress}} while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a {{term:death-move|death move}}. features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Cephilith Hatchlings within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. name: Cephilith Novitiate

motives: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Cephilith Novitiates within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. features.name: Sacrifice Self
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Novitiate charge at a target within {{term:far|Far range}} and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

name: Cephilith Priest
text: _A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who_ _has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see_ _wriggling worms._
motives: Break the unbelievers’ minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan’s arrival, sing its praises

features.name: Psychic Blast

features.name: Cerebral Incursion
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ target within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. features.text: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to _{{term:restrained|Restrain}}_ the target until they spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within {{term:close|Close range}} lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}, and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.text: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating their true form. They have {{term:immunity|immunity}} to physical damage and {{term:resistance|resistance}} to magic damage.

features.name: Psychic Scream
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to summon **1d4** Cephilith Abominations, which appear within {{term:far|Far range}}, then choose one to immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}}.

name: Cipactli

motives: Consume, reshape the land, trample

features.text: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to force all PCs within {{term:close|Close range}} to succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **4d6** direct physical damage. features.name: Verdant Explosion
features.text: When the Cipactli marks its last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

name: Cloud Titan
text: _A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest_ _silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and_ _dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure._
motives: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, deal **4d10+14** magic damage and roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by **1d10**.

features.name: Mist Weaver
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** and choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within {{term:close|Close range}} of that point. The Titan is _{{term:hidden|Hidden}}_ to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has {{term:advantage|advantage}} on attacks against creatures inside it. features.name: Nebulous Transformation
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. features.text: Once per scene, **mark any** **number of {{term:stress|Stress}}** to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at {{term:close|Close range}}.

features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Titan blast wind at a target within {{term:close|Close range}}. The target takes **4d6+8** physical damage and is pushed back to {{term:far|Far range}} from their current position.

features.text: When you would gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a **d6**. On an odd result, you don’t gain the {{term:fear|Fear}}. On an even result, you gain 2 {{term:fear|Fear}} instead of 1.

name: Demon Lord Berzug
text: _The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid_ _beast with a serpent’s tail, a lizard’s hind legs, a crab’s claw arms,_ _and a two-faced wolf’s head._
motives: Destroy goodness, sow chaos, unseat rivals

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within {{term:close|Close range}} and force each target to make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within {{term:far|Far range}}. features.name: Crushing Strike
features.text: When a PC marks {{term:hit-points|HP}} from Berzug’s standard attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force them to mark a number of {{term:stress|Stress}} equal to the number of {{term:hit-points|HP}} they marked. You gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Horrifying
features.text: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}_._

features.name: Relentless (3)

When the {{term:countdown|countdown}} triggers, Mitera becomes _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Elemental Breath

**Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice:

2. **_Lightning._** Deal **4d12** magic damage to **1d6** targets within {{term:far|Far range}}, so long as each target beyond the first is within {{term:close|Close range}} of the previous target.

Targets who fail must mark 2 {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}} and 2 {{term:hit-points|HP}}. Targets who succeed must mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} and a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and have {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on {{term:action-roll|action rolls}} that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature.
7. **_Light._** A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to attack all targets within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets this attack succeeds against take **2d20+10** physical damage and are knocked back to {{term:far|Far range}}. Targets who mark {{term:hit-points|HP}} from this attack become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they clear a {{term:hit-points|HP}}. features.text: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within {{term:far|Far range}}, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.text: When Mitera takes damage, roll a **d8**. Permanently remove the “Elemental Breath” option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide {{term:countdown|countdown}} (see “Diamond Hide”).

name: Fallen Shock Troop

features.text: When a PC marks {{term:hit-points|HP}} from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: Fallen Sorcerer
text: _A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life._
motives: Acquire, dishearten, dominate, torment

features.name: Conflagration
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take **2d10+6** direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to trap a target within {{term:far|Far range}} in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ and _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.text: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to {{term:far|Far range}}.

motives: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

features.text: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by **2d10**.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}}.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage
features.text: _Countdown (Decreasing 8)_. When the Realm-Breaker is in the {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} for the first time, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within {{term:close|Close range}}. Each PC within that area must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take **4d8+5** magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes **4d8+5** magic damage.

features.name: Hot-Blooded
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, the Dragon’s blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}. If they can’t mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}, they mark **1d4** {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Severed Shadow
text: _A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces._
motives: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform

features.name: Minion (12)
features.text: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shadow Grapple
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:close|Close range}}. On a success, the target becomes _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ and must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Severed Shadows within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix
text: _The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the_ _Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and_ _multiple sets of metallic feathered wings._
motives: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Elemental Archon
features.text:
**Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to roll a **d4**. Adonix activates the corresponding effect:

1. **_Fire Beam._** Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam’s path must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}. Targets who succeed take {{term:damage-thresholds|Minor damage}}.
2. **_Thunderclap._** All creatures within {{term:far|Far range}} must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and become _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated.
3. **_Lightning Bolt._** Make an attack against a target within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}, dealing **4d8** magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets.
4. **_Ice Storm._** Each PC within {{term:close|Close range}} must succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or mark **1d4** {{term:stress|Stress}} and become _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they spend a {{term:hope|Hope}} to escape.

features.name: Alpha to Omega
features.text: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all {{term:hit-points|HP}} and {{term:stress|Stress}} cleared. Each PC within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}} must succeed on a {{term:presence|Presence}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}. You gain a {{term:fear|Fear}} for each {{term:hope|Hope}} lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form:

features.name: Forsaken
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their {{term:hit-points|HP}}. The {{term:countdown|countdown}} ends if Adonix takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

features.name: Armageddon
features.text: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a **d6**. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a {{term:death-move|death move}}.

name: Temporal Enforcer
text: _A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the_ _Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum._
motives: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Time Looper
features.text: _Countdown (Loop 2d6)._ When the Enforcer first appears, activate the {{term:countdown|countdown}}. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all {{term:hit-points|HP}}, {{term:stress|Stress}}, and conditions. Reroll the {{term:countdown|countdown}} when the Enforcer takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}.

features.name: Move Between Moments
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}, then {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them again.

features.name: Instant Rewind
features.text: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to reroll the die.

features.name: Invert Polarity
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can’t be used to alter a {{term:critical-success|critical success}}.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
text: _A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly_ _sharp claws._
motives: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.text: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against all targets within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **4d6+4** physical damage and are knocked back to {{term:far|Far range}} and _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until their next roll with {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.text: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** to choose a point within {{term:far|Far range}}. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take **2d10+6** physical damage and must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

features.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge
text: _Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava._
motives: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel Invaders, reposition

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of **d6s** equal to {{term:hit-points|HP}} marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. On a success, the target takes **4d8+1** physical damage, loses a {{term:hope|Hope}}, and is knocked back to {{term:close|Close range}}. The Molten Scourge clears a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge’s scales, filling the area within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or take **4d6+6** physical damage and be knocked back to {{term:close|Close range}}. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Major damage}}, roll a **d10**. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within {{term:far|Far range}}. All targets in that area must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **2d10+4** physical damage, mark **1d4 {{term:stress|Stress}}**, and are _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until they clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Lava Splash
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} from an attack within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals **2d10+4** direct physical damage to the attacker.

features.name: Ashen Vengeance (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Molten Scourge marks their last {{term:hit-points|HP}}, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant
text: _No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the_ _lava settles, it’s ground to ash like the dragon’s past foes._
motives: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Cornered
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** instead of spending a {{term:fear|Fear}} to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.text: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}}.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure while within {{term:close|Close range}} of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a {{term:hope|Hope}} and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}. If the PC can’t lose a {{term:hope|Hope}}, they must mark a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against all targets within {{term:close|Close range}}. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take **2d20+2** physical damage, are knocked back to {{term:close|Close range}} of where they were, and must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to smash the ground and kick up ash within {{term:far|Far range}}. While within the ash cloud, a target has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on {{term:action-roll|action rolls}}. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
features.text: _Countdown (1d12)_. **Spend** **a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with {{term:fear|Fear}}. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within {{term:far|Far range}} must make a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **2d10+10** physical damage and are _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ by the rubble until they break free with a successful {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this {{term:countdown|countdown}} is active, trigger the {{term:countdown|countdown}} immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

name: Water Mother
text: _A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water._
motives: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water

features.name: Segmented
features.text: The Water Mother’s body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra **1d10** damage.

features.name: Eat the World
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within {{term:close|Close range}} of her Head must succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} and be pulled within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of her Head.

features.name: Constrict
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make an attack against all targets within {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take **4d8+8** physical damage and are {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force all targets _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ by the Water Mother to mark a {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

features.name: Venom Surge
features.text: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make the target _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until the end of the scene.

name: Wyrmfiend
text: _A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic._ _Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master’s will_ _than as individual beings._
motives: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous Bite
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to make an attack against a PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}}. On a success, deal **4d4+4** physical damage and _Poison_ the target until they succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} Roll (20). While _Poisoned,_ the target must roll a **d6** before they make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}}. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to choose a target and {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} all Wyrmfiends within {{term:close|Close range}} of them. Those Minions move into {{term:melee|Melee range}} of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Wyrmlings
text: _A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they’re furious,_ _hungry, and stupid._
motives: Consume, shred, swarm

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.

features.name: Ravenous
features.text: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a {{term:hit-points|HP}} from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Wyrmlings take {{term:damage-thresholds|Minor damage}} from an attack within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}} against the attacker.

name: Xero the Castle Killer
text: _A castle-sized, bipedal reptile._
motives: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} it.

features.name: Collateral Damage
features.text: Xero’s movement can’t be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero’s path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Gigaton Stomp
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within {{term:melee|Melee range}} takes **4d12** physical damage and is _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ until they wriggle out with a successful {{term:finesse|Finesse}} Roll. Each creature beyond {{term:melee|Melee range}} but within {{term:close|Close range}} must succeed on an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or be knocked back to {{term:far|Far range}}. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}} or take **4d12** physical damage as they land.

features.name: Power Slide
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to move up to {{term:close|Close range}}. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a {{term:strength|Strength}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}} or choose to either mark 2 {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}} or take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}.

features.name: Radioactive Breath
features.text: **Spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can **spend this token** and unleash a beam to {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}. The beam has a width of {{term:close|Close range}}. Each PC in this area must make an {{term:agility|Agility}} {{term:reaction-roll|Reaction Roll}}. Targets who fail take **4d12+12** direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can’t use this feature again until it takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}.

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: Up to three times per scene, **spend any** **number of {{term:fear|Fear}}** to clear an equal number of {{term:hit-points|HP}}.

name: Perfected Zombie
text: _A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength_ _and skill._
motives: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within {{term:far|Far range}} lose a {{term:hope|Hope}} and you gain a {{term:fear|Fear}}.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.text: PCs can’t spend {{term:hope|Hope}} to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack against all targets within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}}. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_ until their next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of the Zombie, you can **spend a {{term:fear|Fear}}** to add the Zombie’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.

name: Zombie Legion
text: _A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh._
motives: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Legion has marked half or more of their {{term:hit-points|HP}}, their standard attack deals **2d6+5** physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.text: The Legion has {{term:resistance|resistance}} to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend {{term:fear|Fear}} as usual to {{term:spotlight|spotlight}} them.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When the Legion takes {{term:damage-thresholds|Minor damage}} from an attack within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make a standard attack with {{term:advantage|advantage}} against the attacker.
